title: An Explainable Clinical Decision Support System for Patient Risk Stratification with Complete and Partial Diagnostic Panels: A Comparative Study of Explainable Boosting Machines and a Hierarchical Additive Deep Network
description: A two-phase explainable clinical decision support system combining classical ML and a custom deep learning architecture with SHAP and LIME explainability to predict patient risk levels under complete and partial diagnostic panels.
supervisor: Prof. Dr. Sharmin Parveen, Dept. of CSE, State University of Bangladesh
